notes.title: ⚒️ Update 1.20.4 is Live!
notes.notes:
✨ Better multiplayer sync, fewer errors, cleaner lobbies, and some long-overdue quality of life improvements. Plus - Tokaido is on discount on Steam until June 11th, so it’s the perfect time to join the journey or bring a friend along!

⛩️ Check out what’s new in the version 1.20.4 below:

[QoL] You'll now get a notification when a player leaves, instead of silently replacing them with an AI.
[QoL] Various minor Quality of Life improvements.
[Fix] Fixed backdoor exploit that allowed more players to join a multiplayer game than intended.
[Fix] Fixed an issue where inactive players were not correctly replaced by AI.
[Fix] Improved synchronization between players for smoother games.
[Fix] Fixed sync issues when the Host leaves or loses connection.
[Fix] Refined button positions and visibility in the lobby.
[Fix] Corrected the player count display when AI players are present.
[Fix] Fixed graphical artifacts appearing when a building was placed near the Coast for iOS and Android.

notes.title: Tokaido 1.7 update is available !
notes.notes:
Greetings travelers,

We are pleased to announce the release of version 1.7 of Tokaido for PC and MAC platforms!
This update fixes issues regarding Chuubei ability when he encounters a Shokunin at an intermediate Inn.
Funforge account system has been deleted from the game. You can now play online without it. Your Steam nickname will be displayed in the game when you play online.

Plugins and game engine has been updated to optimize performances and be compatible with new standards.

Feel free to contact our support if you encounter issues with the game, or if you want to share your feedback with us.
(Support link: https://funforgesupport.freshdesk.com/support/home )

We wish you a good visit along the Tokaido road, rich in encounters, souvenirs and delicious meals.

notes.title: Tokaido 1.6 update is available !
notes.notes:
Greetings travelers and travelers,

We are pleased to announce the release of version 1.6 of Tokaido for PC and MAC platforms!
This update fixes issues with unlocking Steam Achievements.
Steam Achievements should now track your progress and unlock without issue.
Thanks a lot to the players who contacted us about this.

Corrections have also been applied to the 2 players Pass & Play mode to prevent the game from crashing. We hope these fixes have fixed these issues.

Feel free to contact our support if you encounter issues with the game, or if you want to share your feedback with us.
(Support link: https://funforgesupport.freshdesk.com/support/home)

We wish you a good visit along the Tokaido road, rich in encounters, souvenirs and delicious meals.

notes.title: Patch Note #6 - 04/11/2018
notes.notes:
Hello travelers,

thanks to 'DaveCleasc' who reported this issue in the Community Hub, Tokaido is now supporting 21/9 screen ratio.

Here is a list of screen ratios supported by Tokaido:

- 4:3
- 5:4
- 3:2
- 16:10
- 16:9
- 21:9

Feel free to contact our support if you have an issue with Tokaido.


Thanks for playing Tokaido!

Thomas - Funforge Team

notes.title: Patch Note #5 - 04/06/2018
notes.notes:
Hello travelers,

for this update we have added a Steam friend list in the "Playing with friends" menu.
If you click on a Steam friend, it will send to him an invitation to join you in Tokaido. (Your friend must be online to send him your invitation)

Accepting an invitation will only start the game, your friend will have to go to the online menu and join your game room if you've created one.

Bug fix:
- AI Hiroshige's ability at Inn could went wrong.


Feel free to contact our support if you have an issue with Tokaido.


Thanks for playing Tokaido!

Thomas - Funforge Team

notes.title: Patch Note #4 - 03/29/2018
notes.notes:
Hello travelers,

we have heard that some AI cheat, so we fixed some bugs to avoid that.

- AI Hirotada will use his ability to the Temple correctly when he goes to the Temple with only one coin. (No more negative coins total when he leaves the Temple)
- AI Satsuki is no more able to eat the same meal at the Inn.
- If AI Hiroshige is the first to complete a panorama, he will be the only one winning the completion achievement.

Feel free to contact our support if you have an issue with Tokaido.


Thanks for playing Tokaido!

Thomas - Funforge Team

notes.title: Patch Note #3 - 02/01/2018
notes.notes:
Changes:

- Crossplatform with the latest Android/iOS versions is working with online games.
- Online with AI is now available.
- Pass & Play with AI is now available.
- Chinese language available.
- Friends panel issue fixed. You can now see all your friends and add new ones.
- Negative among of coins issue fixed.
- Pathfinding improved to avoid travelers to be stucked. (This time I'm 99.9% this is fixed for good!)
- Window mod is available. You have to press "F" key to activate or deactivate it. The window is resizable but keep a 4:3, 16:9 ratio to avoid interface glitches.

notes.title: Patch Note #2 - 01/11/2018
notes.notes:
Konnichiwa travelers!

You are now able to choose your character between two random travelers as the usual boardgame rule. You have to click on the random button on the character selection screen. (marked as "?")

We've improved the pathfinding of AI and hope it will fix the "stuck issue", please tell us if you still encountered this bug after updating.


Have a nice and peaceful trip on the Tokaido road!

Thomas - Funforge Team

notes.title: Patch Note #1 - 01/08/2018
notes.notes:
First of all, thanks for playing Tokaido, your support and feedbacks.


Changes:

- Steam achievements are fixed.
About the Shogun achievements, if you are already in the leaderboard, you will need to finish an online game to unlock them.

- Facebook and Twitter buttons have been deleted, as long as achievements linked to these.



We will continue to improve the game, thanks again for your help.

Funforge team wishes you a happy new year 2018.
